category: currency exchange rate API (fiat and crypto, with history)

free_tier.stated: Free plan, USD 0, no card: 1k requests a month and 60 requests an hour, hourly updates, all base currencies.
free_tier.notes: Standard is USD 10 a month for 10k requests, 10-minute updates, no rate limit, historical data back to 1999 and a conversion endpoint, listed as features added to the free ones. Professional is USD 30 a month for 500k requests and adds time series. The pricing page says 1999 for history and the home page says 1990.

egress.terms: not metered in bytes; the 1k requests a month bound what a free key can pull

interface_detail: GET https://api.fxratesapi.com/latest?api_key=KEY with base, currencies and resolution parameters; JSON, XML or TSV
chaining: Hourly rates at 60 requests an hour and 1k a month: a poll every hour would spend 720 of the 1k.

limits.value: 1k requests a month on the Free plan
60 requests an hour on the Free plan

limits_note: History: the pricing page lists historical data as a Standard feature added to the free ones; whether the Free plan can call the historical endpoint was not readable, because the endpoint list lost its check and cross marks. Bulk path: none on the free plan; time series starts on Professional.
binding_note: 1k requests a month ends first: 60 an hour would spend it in about 17 hours.

identity_cost.detail: The docs say to sign up for an account to get an API key, and the pricing page says no credit card is needed. The form fields are unverified: no sign-up page was found.

reliability_note: The free plan's behaviour past its limits was not read; the pricing page names no rate limit on paid plans.
confidence_note: Quota, rate and plan fields are quoted from the first-party pricing page; the sign-up step from the docs. The sign-up form fields and the free plan's history access are unverified. No key was created.
